2607.00514.title: Cross4D-JEPA: Dense Cross-modal Correspondence Distillation for 4D Point Cloud Representation Learning
2607.00514.paper_summary: Automatic understanding of dynamic 4D point clouds, the 3D-point sequences captured over time by depth sensors and LiDAR, is central to robotics and embodied perception. Yet annotating them densely is expensive, making self-supervised pretraining the natural route to transferable representations. Existing pretext tasks, however, are almost entirely intra-modal, and the few methods that transfer knowledge from 2D foundation models rely on a single global embedding per clip, discarding the rich per-patch semantics that these models compute. To address this gap, we propose Cross4D-JEPA, a teacher-student method that distills a frozen 2D foundation model, an image model DINOv2, or a video model V-JEPA 2, into a 4D point encoder. The proposed method combines (1) a dense cross-modal correspondence that maps every 3D point to the teacher patch feature it projects to, and (2) a per-point objective that trains the student to match these features in latent space with no masking, negatives, or decoder. We evaluate Cross4D-JEPA on four benchmarks, MSR-Action3D, DeformingThings4D, NTU-RGB+D 60, and HOI4D, against intra-modal and global cross-modal baselines. Experimental results show that, under a matched protocol, the proposed method consistently outperforms intra-modal and global cross-modal baselines across the four benchmarks and is competitive with heavier published 4D methods; further analysis attributes this gain primarily to the granularity of the correspondence rather than the teacher modality. Beyond recognition accuracy, the dense representation learned by Cross4D-JEPA transfers across domains, improves label efficiency, and improves full-label fine-tuning under the same training budget, while a 13x smaller encoder matches a heavyweight pooling backbone.
2607.00514.paper_summary_zh: 自動理解動態4D點雲，即由深度傳感器和LiDAR隨時間捕獲的3D點序列，對於機器人技術和具身感知至關重要。然後，密集標註這些數據是昂貴的，因此自我監督預訓練成為可轉移表徵的自然路徑。然而，現有的預訓練任務幾乎完全是內模態的，而從2D基礎模型轉移知識的少數方法依賴於每個片段的單一全局嵌入，忽略了這些模型計算的豐富每個區塊語義。為了解決這一差距，我們提出了Cross4D-JEPA，一種教師-學生方法，將一個凍結的2D基礎模型（圖像模型DINOv2或視頻模型V-JEPA 2）提煉為4D點編碼器。所提出的方法結合了（1）密集的跨模態對應，將每個3D點映射到其投影的教師區塊特徵，和（2）一個逐點目標，訓練學生在潛在空間中匹配這些特徵，而不使用掩碼、負樣本或解碼器。我們在四個基準上評估Cross4D-JEPA，MSR-Action3D、DeformingThings4D、NTU-RGB+D 60和HOI4D，與內模態和全局跨模態基準進行比較。實驗結果顯示，在匹配協議下，所提出的方法在四個基準上始終超越內模態和全局跨模態基準，並且與更重的已發表4D方法具有競爭力；進一步分析將這一增益主要歸因於對應的細粒度，而不是教師模態。超越識別準確性，Cross4D-JEPA學到的密集表徵可在不同領域之間轉移，提高標籤效率，並在相同的訓練預算下改善全標籤微調，而一個13倍小的編碼器則能匹配一個重型池化骨幹。
